close_reason: Already fixed. The bead refers to recompute_address_books_with_contents and address_books_with_contents HashSet — those identifiers no longer exist in the codebase. Per bd:JMAP-ic0j.74 (mentioned in the kb note 'memorybackend-objects-mut-silently-auto-registers-accounts-via-known_accounts-insert'), the design was replaced with an incremental address_book_card_counts: HashMap<Id, u32> reverse-index counter maintained by apply_contact_card_index_delta on every per-mutation create/update/destroy/copy. The remaining full-rescan helper is now recompute_address_book_card_counts at memory.rs:261, and it explicitly takes an immutable borrow of self.objects, builds the new HashMap in a local, then takes the mutable borrow via self.aux_mut — exactly the idiomatic two-phase pattern the bead recommended. Doc comment at memory.rs:255-258 says verbatim 'Avoids cloning the ContactCard map.' Only called from seed_object, not from every mutation.
title: recompute_address_books_with_contents clones the entire ContactCard map on every mutation
